inputAttributionLimit: Journal payloads do not encode the input device. OS attribution follows the operator declaration.
countingRule: Count direct player command records from new session branches. Count copied automatic branches separately. Include pre-restore commands even when their receipts are absent from the final save.
screenshotRule: Capture names describe intended checkpoints. Journal commands and saved files determine counts, transaction results and final states.

sourceCapture.captureRule: Read each source file once and retain the captured bytes. A journal may continue to append after capture. Only complete captured JSONL records are retained; any removed trailing fragment is measured. The capture does not claim one simultaneous simulation instant.

preparation.preparation: Original automatic pending-egg checkpoint and source branches copied byte-for-byte; inherited commands are not OS input.
Original automatic ordinary-new-game checkpoint and complete source branches copied byte-for-byte; inherited commands are not OS input.
